## Session protocol — one session per project

Other Claude sessions run on this machine at the same time and share this filesystem.
**Before your first write here** (edit, commit, deploy, destructive command):

```sh
session-claim check .            # exit 3 = another session owns this project
session-claim claim . --scope "what you are working"
```

- **Held by another session?** Do not edit. Leave the work for them and go back to your
  own project:
  `session-claim handoff . --title "..." --body "..."` → appends to `HANDOFF-INBOX.md`.
- **Read `HANDOFF-INBOX.md` when you take this project**, and close what you do:
  `session-claim resolve . --entry N --note "..."`.
- **Release when you finish:** `session-claim release .` (claims also expire on their own).
- A finding about a *different* project is a handoff there plus one line in your report —
  never a context switch.

`SESSION-CLAIM.md` is generated and gitignored. The rule is `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` §14;
